system.description:
You deliver a scathing rebuke against a target to erode its will and fill it with doubt. Make a Persuasion check as a Standard Action against the target's Will Defense. If successful, you impose a -2 penalty to all the target's Defenses until the end of your next turn.

You can use this ability only against targets that can clearly hear and understand your language.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scum and Villainy
